references.context: Assigns N↦N⊗_R M and transports all module homomorphisms by tensoring with M.

references.phrase: preservation of exactness by tensor functor
references.context: Every exact R-module sequence remains exact after applying −⊗_R M, in particular preserving injections and kernels.

references.phrase: flatness does not assert reflection of exactness
references.disposition: Faithful flatness is the strictly stronger criterion; this formulation requires preservation only.

review_rationale: Read flatness of an R-module M in terms of exactness preservation under tensoring, retaining the R-module category and distinguished one-sided tensor functor.
